aiOverview.content: The 2026 Masters Tournament coverage is available on CBS, ESPN, Paramount+, and Prime Video, with extensive streaming on Masters.com and the Masters App. Round 1 and 2 coverage (April 9-10) airs on ESPN (3-7:30 p.m. ET) and Prime Video (1-3 p.m. ET).
